summary: Earnings was boosted by one-off reversal of SAR 53.5 million in accumulated surplus

Earnings was boosted by one-off reversal of SAR 53.5 million in accumulated surplus

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

Saudi Reinsurance Company (Saudi Re) reported a net profit after Zakat of SAR115 million ($30.7 million) for Q2 2026, up 118% from SAR 53 million in the year-ago period, supported by a jump in reinsurance revenue and a one-off reversal of SAR 53.5 million in accumulated surplus.
